perItemFindings.label: S1
perItemFindings.one_line: `FiniteDesign` is only a probability mass function on an arbitrary fintype; it carries neither feasible two-stage assignments, potential outcomes, observation map, estimator, nor the design-based experiment S1 binds. S1 needs a local composite experiment world using `FiniteDesign` as a component, not wholesale reuse.

perItemFindings.label: lem:weak-rational-convex-optimization
perItemFindings.one_line: Its proposed gate is only a bare existence statement for arbitrary `ConvexOn` functions; GLS requires weak-membership and rational approximate-value oracles and supplies an oracle-polynomial algorithm/bounds. This Prop cannot justify constructing `CompilerHandle` or its claimed bit/step bounds.

Recast the GLS gate as the minimal named external oracle-optimization interface, including its oracle assumptions and algorithmic/complexity output, then thread that interface into the compiler proof.
